title: 第4章 不速之客
content_zh:
第4章不速之客
入夜，染坊街，双桂巷。
夜惊堂牵着老马，走过昏暗巷道，左右打量。
鸟鸟转了一天，心情不错，躺在马背行囊之上，爪爪朝天看星星，还哼着小曲儿：
“叽叽叽~……”
染坊街听名字就知道，是手工作坊扎堆的贫民区，如今还没落了，周边只有寥寥几家小作坊，天一黑就再难看到人影。
双桂巷更是如此，常年无人问津，连路面都积了不少树叶，踩上去发出‘擦擦~~’轻响。
刚才在人才市场转了一圈，差事倒是很多，但月俸能到三贯钱的都抢手。
常言‘穷文富武’，夜惊堂作为习武之人，光把练武的家伙事买齐，都得不少银钱，更不用说武夫夸张的食量，这些活儿显然干不成。
虽然没找到差事，但住处倒是有了着落，夜惊堂本以为二两银子，在京城根本没法落脚，结果一番打听，发现了双桂巷这块宝地——整条巷子十几间院落，都是一个房东太太的产业，二两银子一年，想住哪栋住哪栋。
夜惊堂付了半年房租，房东钥匙都没给，过来一看，很符合预期——年久失修的十来间老院子，墙没开裂的几乎没有，门完好无损的只有两三间，感觉不给钱都没几个人乐意住。
夜惊堂一人一鸟吃饱全家不饿，也不在乎这些，找了间看起来像样的院子推门而入。
院内满地落叶，门窗都开着，里面空荡荡就一个床架子，连桌椅都没有。
“叽……”
鸟鸟从马背上跳下来，在屋里转了一圈儿后，乌溜溜的大眼睛望着夜惊堂，意思估摸是——要不咱们回大奶姐姐那里住吧。
夜惊堂没搭理鸟鸟，把马拴在院子角落，喂了点草料，然后将马背上的被褥抱下来。
哒哒——
火镰碰撞出火星，继而昏黄烛光，装满了家徒四壁的寒舍。
夜惊堂把刀靠在墙边，来回打量空荡荡的房间，忽然发现地面挺干净，铺床的干茅草，有些许凹陷，低头仔细打量，还发现了一根长头发。
“嗯？”

夜惊堂拈起长发打量——发质挺好，可以确定时间不会太久远，近期有人在这里住过。
但这时代男女皆为长发，看不出主人性别。
难不成是上个租客留下的……
夜惊堂略显疑惑，但也没太在意，把头发丢去门外后，就拿来床单被褥铺床。
鸟鸟则很调皮，自己啄着小包裹，想从里面拿买来的肉干。
“还吃，没看都住这破地方了？再搞不到银子，下个月就只能把你卖了换钱。”
“叽~”
鸟鸟跳了两下，示意自己是虚胖，卖不了几个大钱。
夜惊堂刚把床单捋平，忽然听到外面传来轻微响动：
好似一阵微风，刮入院子，掀起了地面的落叶。
夜惊堂眉头一皱，握住了身边的刀柄，自仅有装饰作用的窗户往外看去。
院子里多了一道人影！
黑灯瞎火，银月如霜，翻过墙头的月光，只照亮半边院子。
人影立于明暗之间，身上裹着披风，头戴斗笠，看不清胖瘦男女，斜持一杆黑布包裹的长枪。
人影纹丝不动，不言不语，显然也来者不善。
夜惊堂暗暗抬指，让鸟鸟悄悄去找手下镖头，同时将刀横插腰后，来到门口：
“阁下是什么人？这莫非是阁下的住处？”
斗笠客自然是大半夜过来探望年轻人的大奶姐姐。
不过裴湘君并未言语，手中长枪滑出，单手握住了枪尾，平举长枪，在老院中画出一个半圆，指向夜惊堂，同时也抬起了斗笠，可见脸上带着鬼脸面具。
单手持枪尾，举起九尺大枪，没扎实功底根本办不到。

夜惊堂见此不动声色往后退出半步，左手握住了刀柄，严阵以待。但对方并未直接攻来，而是平举长枪手腕轻震。
月下深巷，传出一声鞭响。
包裹在枪身上的黑布瞬间四分五裂，露出黑漆长枪的枪身。
银色枪锋在月下散发出幽森寒芒，黑布震裂后，可以听见枪锋龙吟般的颤鸣
夜惊堂眼神微惊，他单手持枪轻而易举，但直接把包裹的布料震碎，就超出他的能力范围了。
自知不敌，夜惊堂表情一‘喜’，抬眼看向院门处：
“王大侠？！”
裴湘君迅速偏头查看。
夜惊堂猛踏地面拔地而起，飞身跃上房顶，朝着繁华街道方向狂奔。
可惜，这招对寻常武人或许有用，而这次来的可不是寻常人！
夜惊堂跃上房顶，并未听到背后有起跳的动静，上方却传来剧烈破风声。
夜惊堂刀锋出鞘，余光看去，愕然发现刚刚还纹丝不动的斗笠客，后发而先至，越到了三丈高的半空，双手持枪以力劈华山之势，朝他头顶砸来。
房子也不过一丈高，这一跳约等于三层楼，夜惊堂这辈子还是头一次瞧见跳这么高的人，心中不由骇然！
面对泰山压顶般的攻势，夜惊堂迅速持刀横举上方，右手同时抵住刀背。
哗啦——
金铁交击声中，老旧屋顶瞬间垮塌。
夜惊堂一枪被砸入屋里，只觉长枪中蕴含着根本接不住的蛮狠力道，落地后依旧震得脚底板生疼。
“大侠且慢……”
夜惊堂想开口嘴遁，但忽如其来的枪客根本不给机会，从房顶破洞穿入，一枪直接扎向面门。
夜惊堂一刀横劈，巨响声中，屋里爆出几点火星，也吹灭了摇摇欲坠的残烛。

从屋顶扎进来的长枪，就好似一根千斤铁柱，被劈的往侧面横移些许。
夜惊堂抓住机会飞身而起，双手持刀，顺着枪杆削向斗笠客五指，想要反击。
但来人枪尖在地面一点后，就倒着飞出了房顶，轻飘飘落在了房顶上，枪尖斜指庭院，没有再抢攻。
夜惊堂见此急急止步，双手持刀立于身前，保持应敌之姿。
咚咚咚……
月色下的庭院陷入死寂，能明显听到一道快要炸裂的心跳声。
夜惊堂额头带着汗珠，持刀纹丝不动，盯着屋顶的身影。
对峙片刻后，屋顶的人微抬斗笠，发出非男非女的沙哑嗓音：
“你不会‘八步狂刀’？”
夜惊堂眉头一皱，他自幼跟着义父习武，学的都是正常的刀枪功夫，并没有听过八步狂刀的说法。
至于相关秘籍，更未遇到过，边关小城能描写江湖的书籍，都是些《侠女泪》《武林艳史》《艳侠传奇》等杂书，他看的挺多，招式没学会，姿势倒是学了一堆……
“我不过一介镖师，没听过八步狂刀，就会几手杂家把式，阁下可能找错人了。”
“‘八步狂刀’为前朝刀魁开创，传于刀法宗师‘郑峰’。你今天在鸣玉楼亮刀，起手式和八步狂刀形似，朝廷恐怕很快就会找上门。不过你确实不会，不必担心，顶多再打你一顿试深浅。”
还有一顿？
夜惊堂大略可以推断，‘郑峰’就是他义父裴远峰的江湖化名，着实没料到义父还是真宗师。
不过你有这么吊的刀法不早教？
不教就不教，你整个起手式作甚？被人认出来可咋整……
看来今年不能给你烧纸……
夜惊堂心中百转千回，表情倒是自然，他见对方好像是善意提醒，就询问道：
“我未曾听过这些事。阁下是什么人？”

“红财神。”
夜惊堂略微回忆，心中暗惊——‘红财神’他听说过，是江湖豪门‘红花楼’楼主的称号，又称‘枪魁’，位列天下第七，比他义父仇家江湖座次还高。
虽然听江湖传言，‘枪魁’好像换人了，但瘦死的骆驼比马大，怪不得这般厉害……
“原来是红花楼楼主，久仰大名。不知前辈登门，指点我一个晚辈，是何用意？”
“看你是块好料子，惜才。你可想学枪法？”
夜惊堂一愣：“前辈想收我为徒？”
裴湘君手持长枪斜指地面，高手气态十足的道：
“霸王枪一代只传一人，且必须担任红花楼掌舵人。你我初次见面，素不相识，提拜师太早。先展现能力品行，若是够格，才会考虑传你功夫，把红花楼的底细告诉你。”
红花楼和绿匪、平天教等势力不同，属于非常低调的江湖势力，埋头经营自己一亩三分地，不在官府清缴名单之内。
夜惊堂镖局出身，本就是跑江湖的人，能进入这种作风‘正派’的江湖豪门，被江湖巨擘当继承人培养，算一步登天。
夜惊堂并没有拜师学艺的心思，但当前无安生之地，这么大条路摆在面前，一时间也找不到拒绝的理由，他想了想先询问道：
“久仰前辈大名，若有机会学的一手好枪法，在下荣幸之至。不知前辈对在下观感如何？”
“红花楼是生意人，当家武艺很重要，但更重要的是通‘人情世故’。你今日去了裴家，看起来有些渊源，过去给裴家帮忙做事，我自会在暗中观察能力品行。”
夜惊堂眨了眨眼睛，感觉有点不对劲儿，又仔细打量起斗笠客的身材，可惜没看出什么东西……
“家父让我把产业送给裴家，彼此再无瓜葛……”
裴湘君严肃道：“让你去帮忙，拿钱办事互不相欠，又不是让你去当富家少爷。你真不好意思，大不了不要工钱，给亲戚帮个忙，你都不乐意？”
话语沙哑，高手气态十足，但这言辞，怎么听都不像个江湖枭雄……和女人撒娇似的……
夜惊堂心底有些猜测，但不好确认，想想还是点头：
“也罢，就按前辈的意思来。不过我这人脾气直，功夫对我来说是‘鞋子’，鞋子好坏不重要，我只看穿鞋子的人如何。如果往后觉得前辈不合适，还请前辈见谅。”
“江湖人本该如此。我冒然登门，是耽搁你时间，事后无能成否，都不会让你空欢喜一场。”

说完，裴湘君身形自房顶消失，隐入了夜色之中……
content_en:
Chapter 4 Uninvited Guest
At night, Dyefang Street, Shuanggui Lane.
Ye Jingtang led the old horse and walked through the dark alley, looking around.
After wandering around for a day, he was in a good mood. He lay on the horse's luggage and looked at the stars with his claws in the sky, humming a little tune:
"Chi chi chi~..."
As you can tell from the name, Dyefang Street is a slum area with many handicraft workshops. It has not yet been destroyed. There are only a few small workshops around it, and it is difficult to see people after dark.
This is especially true for Shuanggui Alley. It has been neglected all year round. Even the road has a lot of leaves accumulated on it, which makes a soft sound when stepped on.
I just walked around the job market, there are a lot of errands, but those with a monthly salary of three thousand yuan are in demand.
As the saying goes, "the poor in literature and the rich in martial arts", as a martial arts practitioner, Ye Jingtang would need a lot of money just to pay for all the martial arts practitioners, not to mention the martial arts' exaggerated appetite, so it was obviously impossible for him to do this work.
Although he didn't find a job, he found a place to stay. Ye Jingtang originally thought that with only two taels of silver, he wouldn't be able to settle down in the capital, but after some inquiring, he discovered the treasure land of Shuanggui Alley - there are more than a dozen courtyards in the entire alley, all owned by a landlady. For two taels of silver a year, you can live in whichever building you want.
Night Terror Hall paid half a year's rent, but the landlord didn't even give them the keys. When I came over to take a look, it was as expected - there were about a dozen old courtyards in disrepair, with almost no cracked walls and only two or three rooms with intact doors. It felt like not many people would be willing to live there without paying.
One person and one bird in the Night Terror Hall were full and the whole family was not hungry, so they didn't care about these things. They found a decent-looking courtyard and pushed in the door.
The courtyard was covered with fallen leaves, the doors and windows were open, and there was only a bed frame inside, not even a table or chair.
"Ji..."
Niaoniao jumped off the horse, walked around the house, and looked at the Night Terror Hall with his big black eyes. He probably meant--why don't we go back to the big-breasted sister's place.
Ye Jingtang ignored the birds, tied the horse in the corner of the yard, fed some fodder, and then took off the bedding on the horse's back.
Ta da——
The fire sickle collided with sparks, and then the dim candlelight filled the family's humble home.
Ye Jingtang leaned the knife against the wall and looked back and forth in the empty room. Suddenly he found that the floor was quite clean and the dry thatch that made the bed was slightly dented. He lowered his head and looked carefully and found a long hair.
"Huh?"
Ye Jingtang picked up his long hair and looked at it - the hair quality was very good, and he could be sure that it wasn't too long ago, and someone had lived here recently.
But in this era, both men and women had long hair, and the gender of the owner could not be identified.
Could it be that it was left behind by the previous tenant...
Ye Jingtang was a little confused, but he didn't pay much attention. After throwing his hair out the door, he took the sheets and quilts to make the bed.
Birdie was very naughty and pecked at the small package, trying to get the dried meat from it.
"You're still eating, but you're living in this wretched place? If I can't get any more money, I'll have to sell you for money next month."
"Ji~"
The bird jumped twice, indicating that he was too fat and couldn't sell it for a lot of money.
Ye Jingtang had just smoothed the sheets when he suddenly heard a slight noise coming from outside:
It was like a breeze blowing into the yard and lifting up the fallen leaves on the ground.
Ye Jingtang frowned, held the handle of the knife beside him, and looked out of the decorative window.
There is an extra figure in the yard!
The black lamp blinded the fire, and the silver moon was like frost. The moonlight that peaked over the wall only illuminated half of the yard.
The human figure stands between light and darkness, wrapped in a cloak and a bamboo hat on his head. The fat and thin man and woman cannot be seen clearly. He is holding a long spear wrapped in black cloth at an angle.
The figure remained motionless and silent, and it was clear that the visitor was not a good person.
Ye Jingtang secretly raised his finger and asked Niao Niao to quietly find the escort leader. At the same time, he stuck the knife across his waist and came to the door:
"Who are you? Is this your residence?"
The guest in the hat is naturally the big-breasted sister who came to visit the young man in the middle of the night.
However, Pei Xiangjun didn't say anything. He slipped out the spear in his hand and held the tail of the gun with one hand., raised his spear, drew a semicircle in the old courtyard, pointed at the Night Terror Hall, and at the same time raised his bamboo hat, showing that he had a grimace mask on his face.
Holding the tail of the gun with one hand and raising the nine-foot spear is impossible without solid skills.
Seeing this, Ye Jingtang calmly stepped back half a step, holding the handle of the knife with his left hand, ready for battle. However, the opponent did not attack directly. Instead, he raised his spear and shook his wrist lightly.
Under the moonlight, deep in the alley, there was the sound of a whip.
The black cloth wrapped around the gun's body instantly fell apart, revealing the body of the black lacquered spear.
The silver gun blade gave off a ghostly cold glow under the moonlight. After the black cloth cracked, you could hear the gun blade's trembling sound like a dragon's roar.
Ye Jingtang's eyes were slightly frightened. He could easily hold the gun with one hand, but it was beyond his ability to directly shatter the wrapping cloth.
Knowing that he was outmatched, Ye Jingtang's expression was "joyful" and he raised his eyes to look at the courtyard gate:
"Master Wang?!"
Pei Xiangjun quickly turned his head to check.
Ye Jingtang suddenly stepped on the ground, jumped up from the ground, jumped onto the roof, and ran towards the bustling street.
It's a pity that this trick may be useful for ordinary warriors, but this time it's not an ordinary person!
Ye Jingtang jumped up to the roof. He didn't hear any sound of jumping behind him, but there was a violent sound of wind breaking from above.
Ye Jingtang's blade was unsheathed. Looking out of the corner of his eye, he was shocked to find that the man in the bamboo hat who had been motionless a moment ago had arrived first and was three feet high in the air. He held the gun with both hands and smashed it towards his head with the force of splitting the Huashan Mountain.
The house is only one foot high, and this jump is equivalent to about three floors. This is the first time in Ye Jingtang's life that he has seen someone jump so high, and he can't help but feel horrified!
Faced with Taishan's crushing offensive, Ye Jingtang quickly raised his sword horizontally and placed his right hand against the back of the sword.
Wow——
Amidst the clash of gold and iron, the old roof collapsed instantly.
Ye Jingtang was shot into the house. He felt that the spear contained such brutal force that he could not handle it. After landing, it still caused pain in the soles of his feet.
"Hold on, hero..."
Ye Jingtang wanted to open his mouth and escape, but the gunman who suddenly arrived did not give him a chance. He penetrated through the hole in the roof and shot directly to the front door.
Ye Jingtang slashed across the room with his sword. Amidst the loud noise, a few sparks exploded in the room, and the remaining crumbling candles were also blown out.
The spear that penetrated from the roof was like a heavy iron pillar, and it was moved sideways a little.
Ye Jingtang seized the opportunity and flew up. He held the knife in both hands and slashed the fingers of the man in the hat along the barrel of the gun, hoping to fight back.
But after the intruder's spear point hit the ground, he flew out of the roof upside down and landed lightly on the roof. The tip of the spear pointed diagonally at the courtyard and did not attack again.
Seeing this, Ye Jingtang stopped in a hurry and stood with the sword in front of him in both hands, maintaining a posture of responding to the enemy.
Dong dong dong...
The courtyard fell into dead silence under the moonlight, and one could clearly hear a heartbeat that was about to explode.
Ye Jingtang had beads of sweat on his forehead, holding the knife motionless, staring at the figure on the roof.
After a moment of confrontation, the person on the roof raised his bamboo hat slightly and uttered a hoarse voice that was neither male nor female:
“You don’t know how to ‘Eight-Step Crazy Sword’?”
Ye Jingtang frowned. He had practiced martial arts with his adoptive father since he was a child. He had learned normal sword and gun skills and had never heard of the Eight-Step Crazy Sword.
As for the relevant secret books, he has never encountered them. The books that can describe the Jianghu in the border town are all miscellaneous books such as "The Tears of Chivalrous Women", "The Romantic History of Martial Arts", "The Legend of Yanxia", etc. He has read a lot, but he has not learned the moves, but he has learned a lot of postures...
"I'm just an escort. I've never heard of the Eight-Step Crazy Sword, and I know a few tricks. You may have found the wrong person."
"The 'Eight-Step Crazy Sword' was created by the swordsman of the previous dynasty and passed down to the master of swordsmanship 'Zheng Feng'. You are wielding the sword in Mingyu Tower today. Your starting position is similar to the Eight-Step Crazy Sword. I am afraid that the court will come to you soon. But you really don't know how to do it. Don't worry, I will give you another beating to test your skills."
One more meal?
Ye Jingtang can roughly infer that 'Zheng Feng' is the pseudonym of his adoptive father Pei Yuanfeng, but he did not expect that his adoptive father was also the true master.
But you have thisWhy don't you teach your sword skills early?
If you don’t teach, you won’t teach. What’s your starting point? What to do if someone recognizes you...
It seems that I can’t burn paper for you this year...
Ye Jingtang's mind was spinning a thousand times, but his expression was natural. Seeing that the other party seemed to be a kind reminder, he asked:
"I have never heard of these things. Who are you?"
"Red God of Wealth."
Ye Jingtang recalled briefly, and was secretly shocked - he had heard of the 'Red God of Wealth', which was the title of the owner of the wealthy family 'Honghua Mansion', also known as the 'Chief of Spears', ranking seventh in the world, higher than his adoptive father's enemy Jianghu.
Although there are rumors in the world, it seems that the 'gun leader' has been replaced, but the skinny camel is bigger than the horse, no wonder it is so powerful...
"It turns out that he is the owner of Honghua Building. I have admired his name for a long time. I don't know what the senior person's intention is when he comes to visit me and gives advice to a junior like me?"
"I see you are a good material, Xicai. Do you want to learn marksmanship?"
Ye Jingtang was stunned: "Senior, do you want to accept me as your disciple?"
Pei Xiangjun pointed his spear at the ground, and the master said in an angry tone:
"The Overlord Spear can only be passed down to one person in a generation, and he must be the helmsman of Honghua House. You and I are strangers when we meet for the first time. It is too early to propose apprenticeship. Show your ability and conduct first. If you are qualified, I will consider teaching you Kung Fu and tell you the details of Honghua House."
Unlike the Green Bandits, Pingtian Sect and other forces, Honghualou is a very low-key Jianghu force. It concentrates on managing its own three-acre land and is not included in the government's collection list.
He was born in the Ye Jingtang Escort Agency, and he was originally a person who ran around in the world. Being able to enter such a "decent" family and be groomed as the heir by a giant in the world is to reach the sky in one step.
Ye Jingtang had no intention of becoming a disciple, but there was no place for him to settle down. With such a big road ahead of him, he could not find a reason to refuse for a while. He thought for a while and asked first:
"I have admired the name of my senior for a long time. If I have the opportunity to learn good marksmanship, I would be honored. I wonder what my senior thinks of me?"
"Honghualou is a businessman. Martial arts is very important when you are in charge, but more importantly, you need to know the world. You went to the Pei family today. You seem to have some connections. You went to help the Pei family. I will secretly observe your ability and conduct."
Ye Jingtang blinked, feeling something was wrong, and carefully looked at the figure of the man in the hat, but unfortunately he didn't see anything...
"My father asked me to give the property to the Pei family, and we will have nothing to do with each other anymore..."
Pei Xiangjun said seriously: "I asked you to help. We don't owe each other money to do things. We don't ask you to become a young master of a rich family. You are so embarrassed. At worst, you don't need to be paid and you are not happy to help your relatives."
His words are hoarse, and he is full of master's temperament, but his words don't sound like a gangster...like he is coquettishly interacting with a woman...
Ye Jingtang had some guesses in his heart, but it was difficult to confirm. After thinking about it, he nodded:
"Forget it, just follow what senior wants. But I am a straight-tempered person, and kung fu is "shoes" to me. It doesn't matter whether the shoes are good or bad. I only see how the person who wears the shoes is. If you feel that senior is inappropriate in the future, please forgive me."
"This is how people in the world should be. I came here rashly just to waste your time. If I can't do anything afterwards, I won't let your happiness be in vain."
After saying that, Pei Xiangjun disappeared from the roof and disappeared into the night...
